name: Chun Yu Works & Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1949 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, Chun Yu Works & Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer and seller of a broad spectrum of fastening products. Their comprehensive range of fasteners serves various industries, including automotive, bicycle, railway systems, construction, steel structures, electronics, heavy machinery, aerospace, and green energy. Furthermore, the company manufactures collated screws, automatic feed screwdrivers, cold-drawn and annealed wires, as well as bright steel bars and wire rods. Chun Yu Works also delivers specialized services such as surface and phosphating treatments, environmental protection engineering, and waste treatment systems. Their market presence spans Taiwan, Hong Kong, the United States, and numerous other international locations.
